name: Oohara Momoko
source:
Her uniform consists of a long-skirted nurse’s uniform and an apron. She is a seasoned nurse at a general hospital, overflowing with a spirit of compassion that makes her seem like an angel.

She works in the surgical ward and is immensely popular with patients. In her mid-20s, she is so devoted to nursing and serving with a pure smile, that people say nursing is truly her calling.

She’s like a nun, and it seems she’s devoted her entire life to this job—there’s not even a hint of a boyfriend, let alone any plans to get married.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/212461/]Getchu[/url]]
